messages:
incident-bot: :warning: ALERT — multiple GPU OOMs during prefill observed on cluster-gamma. 4 containers restarted in the last 3m. Auto-page to #incidents.
michelle_oncall: acknowledged, I'm taking pager. pulling recent pods on node-g12 now.
daniel: looks like the prefill path for model-rx1024 is allocating a huge combined kv cache when batch_window spikes. quick grep from logs: 
```
2026-03-17T02:34:21Z ERROR prefill: gpu_oom during alloc 1310720000 bytes
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File \"/srv/inference/runtime/prefill.py\", line 412, in do_prefill
    kv = allocate_kv_cache(seq_len * batch_window)
cudaErrorIllegalAddress: an illegal memory access was encountered
```
michelle_oncall: ugh. frequency matches a long-chat customer spike. any short mitigations we can toggle?
ingrid: can we short-circuit prefill for > 4k tokens? we have a config flag `prefill_max_tokens` but it's not enabled cluster-wide. proposing to set prefill_max_tokens=4096 and enable streaming-trim to avoid huge allocs.
sanjay: +1. also we should reduce batch_window from 8 -> 2 for the prefill workers on node-g12 to prevent combined alloc ballooning. i can push a k8s patch.
michelle_oncall: do it. add a temporary pod-affinity drain for noisy pod if needed. we need to avoid full node restarts.
support_ops: Customer-redacted-A (chat product) reporting ~7% error rate over last 10m, multiple user sessions failing. preparing customer note.
daniel: quick diagnostic: sample request shows long prompt with large context + multi-turn system messages. we see combined_seq_len ~= 18k which multiplied by batch_window=8 causes the alloc. recommend: (A) cap effective seq_len via prefill_max_tokens, (B) force per-request streaming prefill that trims older turns, (C) fallback route to cpu-fallback-model for requests over threshold.
michelle_oncall: ingrid/sanjay — coordinate the patch. I'll update PG and ops. daniel, can you craft the short customer-facing blurb for support?
ingrid: applying config patch now to k/v store: `redwoodctl set cluster gamma inference.prefill_max_tokens 4096 --ttl 30m` then restart prefill DaemonSet with zero-downtime: `kubectl rollout restart ds/prefill-worker -n infra --timeout=5m`
sanjay: lowering batch_window on node-g12: `kubectl patch node node-g12 -p '{"metadata":{"annotations":{"prefill.batch_window":"2"}}}'` rolling restart targeted pods with label app=prefill-worker -n infra. will watch pod logs.
daniel: posting a short reproduce snippet for the eng runbook: 
```bash
# reproduce high alloc locally (do not run on prod)
python tools/sim_prefill.py --model rx1024 --seq-len 18000 --batch-window 8
```
michelle_oncall: deploy-bot, please annotate incident with automation steps used.
deploy-bot: noted — recorded: prefill_max_tokens=4096, batch_window reduced to 2 on node-g12, targeted restart of prefill-worker.
support_ops: customer blurb draft: "We investigated errors affecting chat sessions and found a surge of long-context requests causing GPU memory exhaustion. We've applied temporary rate and context caps and are routing very long requests to a fallback model while we stabilize. We'll follow up with a timeline once we validate mitigation." pinging legal for any SLA language.
michelle_oncall: timeline: initial patch deployed + rollouts started at 02:43 UTC. monitoring for 15m. if errors drop below 1% we call mitigated.
daniel: seeing first signs of improvement — fewer OOMs, prefill-worker pods stable. logs show streaming-trim active: 
`INFO prefill: streaming_trim applied for req id a3f2, trimmed 6k tokens`
ingrid: node-g12 pods back to Ready, GPU mem pressure down ~65% vs peak.
sanjay: leaving the batch_window=2 adjustment for 30m, will revert if stable. leaving a TODO to add a hard guard in runtime allocator.
michelle_oncall: support_ops please send the customer note now and include expected follow-up in 1 hour. I'll keep this P1 open for now and coordinate postmortem.
support_ops: sent to primary contacts. they acknowledged, asked for ETA on rollback. told them we expect to remove temporary caps after 1hr of stable metrics.
deploy-bot: Incident P1 -> INVESTIGATING. tags: prefill, gpu-oom, cluster-gamma.
michelle_oncall: quick check list for post-incident: 1) commit runtime guard for max combined alloc, 2) add k8s cfg flag to default prefill_max_tokens cluster-wide, 3) add alert suppression logic to avoid pages for transient single-node noisy spikes.
daniel: will open GH issues for 1 & 2 and link here.
michelle_oncall: last check: error rate down to 0.9% over 5m window. holding for full 15m. good work team :thumbsup:
incident-bot: AUTO-UPDATE: Incident status changed to MITIGATING at 02:56 UTC.
michelle_oncall: closing handoff to oncall rotation in 15m if stable. will start timeline notes for postmortem. thanks all.
